name: Nerifiel Daevaris
source:
The High Garrison's Executive.
Nerifiel is the protagonist's childhood friend. 
His arrival in Eskia is to chase after a slave-trader who captured a Rosenkreuz child.

He has taken care of the protagonist from their early years; someone very kind, although not very honest about his feelings.
